name: 46514 · Elkhart, IN
findings: ZIP 46514 (Elkhart) has 119 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46514 (Elkhart) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46514 (Elkhart) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
